headline: Neighbourhood Watch Member Refuses To Stop Mowing His Lawn During His Neighbour’s Backyard Wedding
body: Local resident Vikram Singh stated he is not expecting his neighbours to only hold weddings in his interest after firing up his industrial-grade weed whacker mid-vow. The neighbourhood watch committee officially categorised the resulting noise pollution as 'a necessary calibration of regional expectations.'
caption: When the HOA and geopolitics collide. We all have that one neighbour who really values their Sunday afternoon lawn maintenance schedule. 🏡✂️ #NeighbourhoodDrama #LawnLife #Expectations (satire)
igHook: Would you keep mowing your lawn if your neighbor was getting married ten feet away?
imagePrompt: A wide-angle, slightly blurry amateur photograph taken from a backyard fence, showing a man pushing a loud, industrial lawnmower near a line of decorative wedding chairs.

sourceHeadline.title: 'Not expecting neighbours to do only what’s in my interest’: Jaishankar on Bangladesh amid Hasina row | India News
